Scene: Behind the bleachers, after evening practice

The air was thick and warm from the heat of the day. The sun dipped lower behind the trees, casting long shadows across the track. Most of the team had already left, a few lingering near the main gate. But Sasha and Sergey had disappeared behind the bleachers under the excuse of “looking for a forgotten water bottle.”

The truth was far more heated.

Sasha was on her knees, her black zip-up hoodie slightly open at the top. Her hair tied in a ponytail. Her lips were slick with spit, breath uneven, and her eyes lit with thrill and hunger. In her hands — Sergey’s shaft, thick and pulsing with tension.

“Almost…” she whispered, voice trembling with need.
“Just a little more… I want you to finish on my face. I want to feel every last drop.”

Sergey gripped the edge of the concrete wall behind him, jaw tight. A moment later, his body tensed, and he came hard — hot release landing on her cheek, her lips, dripping down her neck.

She tilted her head slightly, mouth parted to catch part of it, then stayed there, breathing heavily, face painted in lust and satisfaction.

“Fuck…” he exhaled. “You’re incredible.”

But then—

A loud voice echoed from just around the corner:

“Hey, SERGEY?! You guys back there? What’s taking so long?!”

They both froze.

Sasha turned, wide-eyed — and just beyond the corner stood a classmate, phone in hand, frozen in pure disbelief. Right in front of him: her, on her knees, mouth open, face messy and glistening.

“Wh– what the hell?! I didn’t… I didn’t see anything!” the guy stammered and hurried off, flustered.

Sasha slowly rose, wiping her face with her sleeve, cheeks burning red but her lips curled into a breathless laugh.

“Oh my god…” she whispered. “We actually got caught.”

“At least he didn’t film it…” Sergey muttered, still stunned, zipping up.

Sasha’s eyes gleamed as she stepped closer, not fully cleaned up, whispering low:

“You know what’s the worst part? I’m not even embarrassed. It fucking turned me on.”

She leaned in, smirk playing on her lips.

“Let the whole school talk. They’ll all wonder, but only I know what it feels like — warm, thick, dripping down my chin while I’m looking you right in the eye.”

Then, with a playful glint in her eye, she licked a stray drop from her lip.

“Next time, I want it all in my throat. That way, even if we get caught again… there’ll be nothing left to wipe.”
